title: The gauge, the last January
logline: The rain gauge on the doorframe on the sixth of January, a quarter full, the pup at twelve under the eave beside it out of the rain. The last January's first measurement. The number, as always, not lettered.

panels.composition: A plastic rain gauge nailed to a garage doorframe a quarter full in rain, an old three-legged dog sitting beneath the eave beside it out of the wet.
